description: A newly constructed 4 season motorized trail that now connects Wells to Barkerville for snowmobiles in the winter and in conjunction with the new BGM Trail allows for ORV access the snow free months. Trail travels through Barkerville Historic Townsite Park so please follow all directional signage.
directions: Winter trail can be accessed directly from the hotels in the community of Wells. Please refer to designated snowmobile ORV routes in town.
title: Valley Mountain Pass
